slides.eyebrow: SONGWRITING TRICKS YOU CAN ACTUALLY USE
slides.headline: SING GIBBERISH FIRST.
WORDS FIRST IS A TRAP.
slides.body: Write the lyrics before the melody and you'll end up with a tune that just follows your sentences around.

slides.headline: SO DON'T.
slides.body: Loop your chords. Mumble total nonsense over the top. Sing whatever sounds good, not whatever means something.

slides.headline: THEN FIND WORDS THAT FIT THE SOUND.
slides.body: The melody's already there. Now you're just filling in the shapes.

slides.headline: "YESTERDAY" WAS "SCRAMBLED EGGS" FIRST.
slides.body: McCartney kept the placeholder for months while he hunted for the real words.
